'''Kōzō Mito''' (Japanese: '''三戸耕三''' ''Mito Kōzō'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mito was born on June 8, 1979, in {{wp|Yamaguchi, Yamaguchi}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|RS}}, voicing [[Samuel]], the assistant to {{an|Brandon|Pyramid King Brandon}}. Then, during {{aniseries|DP}}, he voiced his best-known role in the animated series, [[Conway]], one of {{Ash}}'s secondary [[rival]]s in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. Mito is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Production Baobab}}.
